name: shiptrack
description: Open-source shipment tracking for Indian and international couriers. Starts with Blue Dart.
//deploy:web: Cloudflare Workers Builds invokes `npm run deploy:web` as its BUILD command, on every branch — so this script must only build, never deploy. Deploying is the build trigger's own job: `wrangler deploy` on main, `wrangler versions upload` on other branches. If this script deploys, every branch push ships to production. Use `npm run deploy` for a manual full deploy.
//next: Keep next and @opennextjs/cloudflare in step. Next 16.4 moved preview props into a standalone .next/server/preview-props.json; OpenNext < 1.20.12 didn't inline it, so every dynamic route crashed at runtime (Cloudflare 1101) though `next build` passed — this took prod down on 2026-10-12 and forced a 16.3.x pin. OpenNext 1.20.12 fixed it (opennextjs/opennextjs-cloudflare#1356) and 1.20.16+ requires Next >= 16.4.5, so we now track ^16.4 with OpenNext ^1.20.17. A Next/OpenNext bump still passes `next build` while failing at runtime, so always boot a dynamic route before merging one.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && npm run deploy:poller
scripts.db:migrate: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute shiptrack --file=$f || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute shiptrack --remote --file=$f || exit 1; done

//overrides: All three are transitive build/dev-only deps (never in the deployed Worker), forced up to clear Dependabot alerts the parents haven't released a fix for yet. sharp: wrangler -> miniflare, GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c (libheif). undici: wrangler -> miniflare, several 7.x advisories fixed in 7.30.1. body-parser: @opennextjs/cloudflare -> aws -> express, DoS GHSA fixed in 2.4.0. Drop each once its parent ships a release that resolves a safe version on its own.
